page_text_ocr_zh:
3月20日
妈妈说我应该永远记住三件事：
1. 地球给了我们需要的一切。
2. 我们钻地道的时候，
也同时帮忙照顾了地球。
非钻地道不可——
帮助地球呼吸！
3. 绝对不要在爸爸
吃报纸的时候烦他。
客兹
page_text_en:
March 20
Mom says I should always remember three things:
1. The Earth gives us everything we need.
2. When we dig tunnels,
we also help take care of the Earth.
We must dig tunnels—
helping the Earth breathe!
3. Never bother Dad
when he's eating the newspaper.
Crunch!
summary_zh: 蚯蚓在日记中记录妈妈教给它的三件事：地球提供一切、钻地道帮助地球呼吸、不要打扰吃报纸的爸爸。

3月29日
今天我努力教
蜘蛛怎样钻地。

一开始他全部的脚都卡住了，
我想我有一个脚踝
扭伤了。

后来他又吞了一堆土。
我放弃了。

明天他要教我怎样倒立走路。
page_text_en:
March 29th
Today I tried hard to teach
the spider how to dig.

At first, all his legs got stuck,
I think I sprained my ankle.

Then he swallowed a pile of dirt.
I gave up.

Tomorrow he's going to teach me how to walk upside down.
summary_zh: 蚯蚓在日记中记录了自己尝试教蜘蛛钻地的经历，蜘蛛因脚卡住、吞土而失败，蚯蚓最终放弃，并计划明天教蜘蛛倒立走路。

page_text_ocr_zh:
4月1日

page_text_en:

page_text_ocr_zh:
4月20日
今天我偷偷靠近公园里的一些
小孩，他们没听到我来了。
我在他们面前扭来扭去，
他们大声尖叫。
我就爱看他们这个样子。
page_text_en:
April 20th
Today I sneaked up on some kids in the park. They didn’t hear me coming.
I wiggled around in front of them,
and they screamed loudly.
I just love seeing them like this.
summary_zh: 蚯蚓在4月20日的日记中记录，它偷偷靠近公园里的小孩，在他们面前扭动，导致孩子们尖叫，它觉得这很有趣。

5月1日
爷爷教过我们，礼貌非常重要。
所以今天我对遇到的
第一只蚂蚁说“早安”。
早安。
队伍里还有
六百只蚂蚁。
早安、早安、早安、你好吗？早安、见到你真高兴！你好！早安、早、早、你好！早安、早安、早安……
我在那里
站了一整天。
page_text_en:
May 1st
Grandpa taught us that manners are very important.
So today I said "Good morning" to the first ant I met.
Good morning.
There were six hundred ants in the line.
Good morning, good morning, good morning, how are you? Good morning, so glad to see you! Hello! Good morning, good, good, hello! Good morning, good morning, good morning...
I stood there
all day long.
summary_zh: 蚯蚓在5月1日的日记中记录，爷爷教导它礼貌很重要，于是它对遇到的第一只蚂蚁说“早安”，并为了向整支蚂蚁队伍问好而站了一整天。

5月8日
昨天晚上我做了一个
最可怕的恶梦——
巨大的鸟在玩跳房子！
妈妈说我睡觉前
不可以再吃那么多
垃圾了。
立顿茶袋
page_text_en:
May 8th
Last night I had a
really scary nightmare—
A giant bird playing hopscotch!
Mom said I shouldn't eat
so much garbage before bed.
Lipton Tea Bag
summary_zh: 蚯蚓在5月8日的日记中记录了自己做了一个可怕的噩梦：一只巨大的鸟在玩跳房子；妈妈因此提醒它睡前不要吃太多垃圾。画面左侧是噩梦场景，右侧是蚯蚓在茶袋里睡觉。

page_text_ocr_zh:
5月15日
今天我和蜘蛛吵架。
他跟我说有脚才算酷，
然后他就跑了，我追不上他。
也许他说得没错。
5月16日
我逗蜘蛛笑，
他笑得太厉害了，
结果从树上掉下来。
谁说一定要有脚呢？
石平！
page_text_en:
May 15th
Today I argued with the spider.
He told me having legs is cool,
then he ran away, and I couldn't catch him.
Maybe he was right.
May 16th
I made the spider laugh,
he laughed too hard,
and fell off the tree.
Who says you need legs?
Thud!
summary_zh: 蚯蚓在5月15日与蜘蛛争论有脚是否才算酷，5月16日它逗蜘蛛大笑，导致蜘蛛从树上摔下，蚯蚓因此觉得没有脚也无所谓。

把头向前摆，

page_text_en:
May 28th
Last night I went to the school dance.
Move your head forward,
Move your head backward.
Twist your body and spin around,
We can only dance like this.

June 15th
My sister thinks she's beautiful!
I told her, no matter how much time she spends looking in the mirror, her face will always look just like her bottom.

The spider thinks

Mom doesn't think so.

July 4th
When I grow up, I want to be a secret agent. Spider says I have to be very careful, because the president might accidentally step on me.

page_text_en:
August 1st
As an earthworm,
there are times when things are tough.
Our bodies are small, and sometimes everyone
even forgets we're here.

However, just like Mom always says,
the Earth will never forget
our existence.
summary_zh: 蚯蚓在8月1日的日记中写道，虽然自己身体小，常被忽略，但地球永远不会忘记它们的存在。
